cohort: 100 pregnant women with gestational diabetes at a peripheral (Class C) hospital in Pakistan
finding: Neither maternal age, parity, nor presence of maternal co-morbidities predicted insulin requirements in pregnant women with gestational diabetes.
mod_finding: Insulin requirements to control hyperglycemia did not correlate with mode of delivery.
birth_weight: 3.30+-0.33 kg in patients requiring insulin; 3.26+-0.25 kg in other treatments
